title: Towards Measuring Fairness in Grid Layout in Recommender Systems
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study. The study focused on how fairness metrics for recommender systems change based on layout (linear vs. grid) and user browsing models, using author gender as the protected attribute.
